## The Weight of Silence

11pm, the world stood still,<br />
Taking a break from life’s loud thrill.<br />
Reflecting on the days gone by,<br />
Pondering why the spirit’s run dry.<br />

"What is this weight, this endless drain,<br />
Tugging hard on heart and brain?"<br />

Seeking answers, searching deep,<br />
Tracing the month where shadows creep.<br />
And there it stands, the final word<br />
A truth, though harsh, silently heard:<br />

> Undervalued.

Ideas rise, yet fade away,<br />
Unless they match what others say.<br />
The silent truth, a bitter note:<br />
Your voice? It doesn’t float.<br />

But let it be, and heed the call:<br />
"Doesn’t matter much at all."<br />

Ideas fall on ears of stone,<br />
So keep them close, keep them your own.<br />
For in the quiet, power’s found,<br />
When silence is your battleground.<br />
